alt_title: UPI on Dhanteras: The Month's Busiest Days, 2023-2025
description: Dhanteras was one of the two busiest days of its month for UPI payments in 2023, 2024 and 2025 (NPCI daily data). On Dhanteras 2025 (18 Oct), UPI carried 754.37 million payments, about 75 crore, October's most.

On Diwali day itself, the rupee value of UPI payments was lower than on Dhanteras in all three years (−28% in 2025). By number of payments the picture is mixed: Diwali 2024 was its month's busiest day. Dates of Dhanteras and Diwali are as in the government's greetings (PIB).
question: Do you pay by UPI on Dhanteras?
x: Dhanteras was a top-two day for UPI payments in 2023, 2024 and 2025. Dhanteras 2025: 754.37 million payments, October's most. On Diwali day, rupee value was lower than Dhanteras all three years. Source: NPCI daily data.
